description: Express.js route handlers for user authentication and cart management in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CartClass
classes.description: Module for cart operations such as adding, decreasing quantity, and generating cart model.

methods.name: POST /signin
methods.description: Handles user registration with validation and duplicate check.

methods.name: POST /login
methods.description: Handles user login, JWT token generation upon successful authentication.

methods.name: GET /:userId/cart
methods.description: Retrieves the cart for a specific user.

methods.name: POST /:userId/cart
methods.description: Adds or updates items in the user's cart, including handling products and variants.

methods.name: PUT /:userId/cart
methods.description: Replaces or updates the entire cart for a user.
